Almost 11 mo ago, I posted a comment on importance of EDA when Rahul Lanka  asked me. Reposting !"
""
"Importance of Exploratory Data Analysis"
""
"In a DS project, your model can be a black box but your data shouldn't be. To understand what are the features, sizes, shape, their ranges, number of unique values, how they are correlated to target variable etc. and a lot more, you need to do EDA. "
""
"And there are tons of ideas (hypothesis), you generate while doing EDA. For example, in a regression problem, I realized doing clustering and generating a new feature with clustered labels and then proceeding with regression helped me increase accuracy. It made business sense too.  "
""
"I saw many such benefits of EDA in real life. EDA is advanced version of reporting /BI/ dashboard. Business wise, it adds much more value than modelling. If your model fails, your client may still be happy with insights you gave from EDA. Hence, it's a backup deliverable. "
""
"EDA is exhaustive so there are some basic factors to check but it's not a sing list. If you are keen on getting good at EDA, go to kaggle, pick popular competitions and check out kernels with EDA."
""

Many people ask me which course to choose when learning DS. Here are a few questions you can ask when you make decision "
""
"1. Is it live or recorded ? Can you really sit and listen to recordings ?"
""
"2. How much %  of course is hands on and does it suit your current level of coding expertise , who answers doubts ?"
""
"3. How many guided projects are there ? Ask for previous project Reports of students"
""
"4. How much personalised the course is ? Do you get any mentoring support ?"
""
"5. How accessible are the people who teach you?"
""
"6. If any policy like placement assistance is mentioned - is it only resume review or you get recruiters access ? Any conditions for guaranteed schemes ?"
""
"7. If you are getting certificate with any academic institute name - how much is it appreciated in the industry ? Does that academic institute has expertise in DS ? Does the profs of institute do consulting/research in AI with notable achievements ?"
""
"8. More importantly, refund policy which allows you to pull back if you don’t like within a week or so"
""
"9. Talk to one successful student and one not so successful student directly. Ask the institute to give contact details. "
""
"10. Look at marketing as well. Which gives you fair idea where your money goes."
""
"Choose wisely and don’t regret later. Don’t fall for sheen !
